name: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd.
summary: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. manufactures and markets CNC systems and functional components in China. It offers servo driver; five-axis vertical and horizontal machining center, turning and milling composite machining, gantry machining, blade machining, tool grinding, and blade tip grinding center technology platform; five-linkage bladed disk machining center; motor; electric spindle; sensing system; milling head; and turntable components. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Dalian, China.
